title: Dogfooding requirements for 50 products
summary: Prepare all 50 products for internal dogfooding using T4H brands as trial customers. Machines must search, map, order, prepare scripts, log gaps, and create evidence-ready rows before human walkthrough. Human input is required only at dogfooding moments: purchase, first use, UX/HX judgement, support, billing, cancellation, and approval to remove HITL.
three_trial_rule: Any new product, billing path, vendor path, UX pattern, or operational claim requires three successful internal trials before no-HITL operation is permitted.
close_condition: All 50 products represented or explicitly missing, dogfooding order prepared, test scripts prepared, three-trial rule encoded, no product marked REAL without evidence.
